title: pvExtractCellsAlongLinesCustomSource
body:
## pvExtractCellsAlongLinesCustomSource

Extracts the input cells intersected by the line and polyline cells of a second dataset (Source, polydata or unstructured grid) and outputs them as an unstructured grid. Use it with a curved or multi-segment path, e.g. a traced streamline or a polyline read from a file; for a single straight segment pvExtractCellsAlongLine is simpler.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Only line and polyline cells of Source are used; polygons, vertices or 3-D cells in Source are ignored, so extract edges or build a polyline first.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ExtractCellsAlongLinesCustomSource`. Identity: `filters/ExtractCellsAlongLineCustom`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); composite data (multiblock or partitioned collections) (vtkCompositeDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkCompositeDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
| `Source` | Required data input for the native Source port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the dataset composed of the lines and poly lines used to extract cells in the input. Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData); unstructured grids (vtkUnstructuredGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData","vtkUnstructuredGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
